specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_empty
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums),
    nums = [] → longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond = 0

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums),
    longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums),
    0 = longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_nonempty_pos
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums),
    nums ≠ [] → longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_two_increasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond [a, b]),
    a = b → longestIncreasingStreak [a, b] h_precond = 2

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_two_nonincreasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond [a, b]),
    ¬(a = b) → longestIncreasingStreak [a, b] h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_result_pos_iff_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond nums),
    (longestIncreasingStreak nums h_precond = 0) ↔ (nums = [])

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : List Int) (h : longestIncreasingStreak_precond args),
    longestIncreasingStreak_postcond args (longestIncreasingStreak args h) h

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_constant
specs.stmt: Nat) (n : Int) : longestIncreasingStreak (List.replicate k n) trivial = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingStreak_lower_bound
specs.stmt: List Int) (h : longestIncreasingStreak_precond l) (h_nonempty : l ≠ []) : longestIncreasingStreak l h ≥ 1
